02About Us

An integrated Saudimanufacturer

Nuor Steel Industry Company is a Saudi manufacturer of TMT rebar and steel billets, based in Al Kharj Industrial City. It began in 2010 as a steel trader, then moved into manufacturing with an integrated melt shop and rolling mill.

Today its production capacity exceeds 250,000 tons a year, with a team of more than 250 people. Its operations run on smart systems for data, product and customer tracking, automated production lines and an in-house quality lab.

Nuor Steel supplies every region of the Kingdom, the GCC and the Middle East, backed by local and international quality certifications.

07Quality, Lab & Traceability

Quality,precisely tested

No Nuor Steel product leaves the plant before passing our in-house quality lab, where its chemical composition and mechanical properties are checked on high-precision testing equipment.

Precision · 0.01 mm
01

3D rib scanning

A German ECM Datensysteme system scans each bar in 3D, measuring rib height, spacing and angle without contact, to 0.01 mm.

02

Mill Test Certificate supplied with shipments

03

Certified calibration

Testing equipment calibrated with certified tools.
